test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - English (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: english
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

I wanted to play tennis / but my parents / prevented me to join /the school team.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: **prevented me to join**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Replace "**prevented me to join**" with "**prevented me from joining**" to correct the sentence.
 
• The verb "**Prevent**" is always followed by the preposition "**from**", not "**to**".
 
• If we want to use a verb after a preposition, it must be in "**-ing**" form. It is incorrect to use an infinitive after a preposition.
 
• Here, in the given sentence the verb is "**join**" and as per the rules it should be "**joining**".
 
• When a gerund (joining) follows a preposition, it's called an "**object of the preposition**."

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**, which contains an error.

**Corrected sentence:*** *I wanted to play tennis but my parents prevented me from joining the school team.
